problem: The home/audio slice still lacks an explorable world, neighbors with requests and meaningful journeys.
reuseDecision: Extend the current deterministic generator with an additive envelope. Reuse shared proximity selection, pooled Three.js geometry, resident limbs, home/audio lifecycle and explicit state reducers. Native dialog supplies accessible focus handling; no new package or second game router. Reviewed Three.js InstancedMesh and Raycaster documentation before extending rendering.
nonGoals: Copy Nintendo assets, text, music or branding
Claim full island multiplayer, full NPC schedules or infinite quest content
acceptance: Three reproducible regions have reachable docks and targets
Four requests validate resources and award once
Collectibles, discoveries, deliveries and travel survive reload
Keyboard/touch dialogue, journal/map and boat travel work
Types, production build, bundle limits and browser evidence pass without gate relaxation
